visual_action: Singers Beyoncé and Kelly Rowland walk hand-in-hand onto a stage in a large arena filled with a cheering crowd. Many people in the audience are holding up their phones to record and waving signs. The two women walk across a blue-carpeted stage, hug a third woman, and then stand behind a lectern bearing the seal of the Vice President of the United States, smiling at the crowd.
